en: Puggalapaññatti Niddesa 10. Exposition of the Ten Designations of Persons (Dasakapuggalapaññatti)
Of which five is there finality here?

Of the one who has seven more births at most, of the clan-to-clan, of the single-seed, of the once-returner, and of the one who is an arahant in this very life—of these five, there is finality here. –5
Of which five is there final attainment here,

having left this world? Of one who attains nibbāna in the interval, one who attains nibbāna upon arrival, one who attains nibbāna without exertion, one who attains nibbāna with exertion, and one who goes upstream to the Akaniṭṭha realm—
it is of these five that there is final attainment here, having left this world.
To this extent is the description of persons as "person-designations.
This is the Exposition of the Decads.
